name: Zoth ZeUSD
oneLiner: ZeUSD is Zoth's CDP-style dollar stablecoin, minted against tokenized RWA collateral (USYC, STBT, TBILL, Wrapped M) and off-chain T-bills and MMFs.
collateral: U.S. Treasury bills, ETFs, money market funds, and reverse repos (off-chain), and tokenized on-chain RWAs (e.g., Hashnote USYC, Matrixdock STBT, OpenEden TBILL); held in smart contract escrow vaults or traditional/omnibus escrow accounts
pegMechanism: CDP: users deposit eligible RWA collateral to mint ZeUSD; peg maintained through LTV ratios and collateral redemption (repay ZeUSD to reclaim collateral)

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: ZeUSD resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

mintAuthority.summary: ZeUSD token minting is restricted to a router contract, but an EOA holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE/ADMIN_ROLE on the token and can set the router and authorize upgrades.

controls.label: ZeUSD router
controls.evidence: ZeUSD.router() returned this proxy. ZeUSD source shows mint(address,uint256) is onlyRouter; router source exposes mintWithCollateral and mintWithStable routes.

controls.label: ZeUSD token owner/admin EOA
controls.evidence: ZeUSD.owner() returned this EOA; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) and hasRole(ADMIN_ROLE) both returned true. RoleGranted logs show this address received both roles during initialization.

review.evidence: Direct reads and Sourcify source identify a router-only token mint path plus an EOA token owner/admin that can set the router and authorize upgrades.
unresolvedQuestions: Router admin role grants include additional addresses in logs; final row should review the router's own access-control implementation and current active admin set.
No multisig setup was verified for the token owner/admin EOA.

reserves.name: Tokenized U.S. T-Bills & MMFs (USYC, STBT, TBILL, ZTLN-P)

notices.title: March 2025 exploit history
notices.message: Zoth suffered March 2025 exploits affecting ZeUSD platform risk, including a collateral-accounting bug and a later admin-key compromise. Review current redemption and reserve evidence before assuming normal peg liquidity. https://www.halborn.com/blog/post/explained-the-zoth-hack-march-2025
